تمتثلون (form VIII)
# تَمْتَثِلُونَ (tamtaṯilūna) /tam.ta.θi.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# تُمْتَثَلُونَ (tumtaṯalūna) /tum.ta.θa.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
